findings.description: The umbrella shaft is still visible rising in front of the woman, but neither hand is gripping it: her right hand is open with palm up and fingers spread, and her left hand is holding the apple. From 0:00-0:06 the shaft was clearly held in her left hand; when the apple moved to that hand, the umbrella lost its support and appears to float in mid-air with its lower end terminating near her chin with no attachment.

A distinct light/blonde patch appears on the top-front of her dark brown hair at 0:02, whereas the same region is uniformly dark brown at 0:00 and 0:04. Could be a moving sun highlight through the awnings, but the abrupt appearance/disappearance of a discrete light region suggests possible color instability.
